audit_metadata.title: Phase 9.1.4.2 Canonical Classification Label Reconciliation & Uncertainty Semantics Closure
audit_metadata.audit_objective: Establish deterministic, empirical-delineation-uncertainty-grounded canonical classification labels (STABLE, EXPANDING, UNUSUAL_CHANGE, AMBIGUOUS), verify GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY semantics against Rawlins et al. (2026), align ambiguous diagnostic boundaries, separate operational heuristics from physical ML classes, harden class-weight and predictor-leakage validation, and verify partition integrity prior to Phase 9.2 model training.

uncertainty_semantics_audit.source_publication: Rawlins, L. D., Watson, C. S., Bhambri, R., Khadka, N., & Chand, M. B. (2026). Earth System Science Data, 18, 5143-5165. doi:10.5194/essd-18-5143-2026
uncertainty_semantics_audit.glo_area_uncertainty_formula: AREA_UNCERTAINTY(A) = round(0.0488 * A^0.537, 3) [km²], derived from error% = 4.88 * A^(-0.463) fitted to Sentinel-2 DL vs. n=895 manual digitizations
uncertainty_semantics_audit.empirical_match_verification: 100.0000% exact match across all 18,129 Sentinel-1 and 22,294 Sentinel-2 records (40,423/40,423)

observed_serial_dependence_diagnostics.interpretation: Observed serial dependence diagnostics indicate that the derived cross-sensor discrepancies and annual changes are not temporally independent as observed quantities. These diagnostics do not independently identify the covariance of the underlying measurement errors.

uncertainty_semantics_audit.combined_scale_interpretation: U_RMS = sqrt(0.25 * (u_S1_t^2 + u_S1_t1^2 + u_S2_t^2 + u_S2_t1^2)) is a purely descriptive Root-Mean-Square empirical delineation-error scale requiring no Gaussian or independence assumption. Multipliers 1.0x and 3.0x are engineering thresholds, not 1σ or 3σ statistical significance levels. See reports/12_uncertainty_semantics_note.md.

target_definitions.fused_u_rms_km2: FUSED_SIGMA_DELTA (legacy column name for U_RMS) = 0.5 * sqrt(u_s1_t^2 + u_s1_t1^2 + u_s2_t^2 + u_s2_t1^2) [km²]

STABLE.formula: (|delta_area| <= 1.0 * U_RMS) OR (|rel_pct| <= 5.0) OR (delta_area < 0 AND delta_area >= -3.0 * U_RMS AND rel_pct >= -20.0)
STABLE.physical_rationale: Captures observations within the 1.0x empirical delineation-error floor, within +/-5.0% relative change, or within moderate annual contraction bounds. Grouping moderate annual contraction into STABLE is a project-defined classification convention; annual area observations alone do not establish physical causes such as evaporation or border freezing.

EXPANDING.formula: NOT STABLE AND delta_area > 1.0 * U_RMS AND delta_area <= 3.0 * U_RMS AND rel_pct > 5.0 AND rel_pct <= 20.0
EXPANDING.physical_rationale: Positive annual expansion exceeding the 1.0x empirical delineation-error scale and +5.0% relative change, bounded above by 3.0x U_RMS and +20.0%.

UNUSUAL_CHANGE.formula: (delta_area > 3.0 * U_RMS AND rel_pct > 20.0) OR (delta_area < -3.0 * U_RMS AND rel_pct < -20.0)
UNUSUAL_CHANGE.physical_rationale: Threshold-defined unusual change: extreme annual expansion (>3.0x U_RMS and >20.0%) or extreme annual contraction (<-3.0x U_RMS and <-20.0%). Not independently verified hazard or GLOF events; event evidence is kept strictly separate from this annual-area target.

AMBIGUOUS.physical_rationale: Label-exclusion state (not a 4th learned physical class) for observations with conflicting relative-change magnitude and empirical delineation-error scale. Excluded from 3-class supervised training.

category_a.physical_interpretation: Small lakes with relative expansion > 20.0% and positive absolute change between 1.0x and 3.0x U_RMS (delineation edge error amplified by small area denominator).

category_b.physical_interpretation: Large lakes with absolute expansion > 3.0x U_RMS but moderate relative expansion between 5.0% and 20.0%.

category_c.physical_interpretation: Small lakes with relative contraction < -20.0% and negative absolute change between -3.0x and -1.0x U_RMS (relative magnitude amplified by small area denominator).

category_d.physical_interpretation: Large lakes with absolute contraction < -3.0x U_RMS and moderate relative contraction between -20.0% and -5.0%.

root_cause_analysis_previous_inconsisten.summary: Discrepancies across early Phase 12 artifacts arose from inconsistent handling of the 897 ambiguous observations across different reporting scripts.

discrepancy_details.cause: Accurately recorded the true conjunctions of the hybrid definition, explicitly isolating 897 ambiguous observations.
Initialized labels to STABLE and forced 500 positive ambiguous observations into EXPANDING (77 + 500 = 577) and 397 negative ambiguous observations into STABLE (10760 + 397 = 11157).
Reassigned Category C small-lake negative contractions (rel < -20%, N=393) to UNUSUAL_CHANGE (115 + 393 = 508), contradicting the formal rule conjunctions.

root_cause_analysis_previous_inconsisten.resolution: Phases 9.1.4 and 9.1.4.1 enforce the mutually exclusive 3-class + explicit AMBIGUOUS exclusion taxonomy across all artifacts.

operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.legacy_risk_engine_compatibility_note: New RiskEngine elevated alerts emit canonical internal status 'ELEVATED_ALERT' (mapped to user-facing 'ELEVATED ALERT'). Previously persisted records or external callers using legacy 'UNUSUAL_CHANGE' remain readable via map_status_to_user_facing() and dashboard_data/dashboard consumers. Operational alert statuses must NEVER be used as supervised training targets.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.abstention_separation: WATCH, STALE, STALE_DATA, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA are operational quality/alert states, NOT physical lake-change categories.
operational_rules_vs_ground_truth_isolat.independent_target_formulation: Supervised labels are constructed strictly from consecutive annual area observations and GLO AREA_UNCERTAINTY, completely independent of RiskEngine and separate from cryospheric event inventories.

scientific_validation_guardrails.class_weights_policy: Class weights must be calculated strictly from validated, non-null, unambiguous training observations (Train <=2021, N=7,880) only.
scientific_validation_guardrails.exhausted_test_year_2023: The 2023 historical test partition (N=1,742; 1,612 unambiguous) was already used in NB09 and NB11. Any further test-set evaluation, threshold selection, hyperparameter tuning, or model selection using 2023 is strictly prohibited. Previously reported benchmark metrics (MAE=0.004792 km², RMSE=0.015079 km², R²=0.3366) are preserved as historical references only.
scientific_validation_guardrails.status_of_year_2024: 2024 area values were consumed to construct the 2023 target; 2024 has no consecutive next year (2025 unavailable) and remains unavailable as an untouched future holdout.
scientific_validation_guardrails.leakage_prevention: Row-level random splitting is prohibited. Cross-validation must strictly use lake-level grouping (GroupKFold on GLO_ID). Preprocessors must fit strictly on training folds.
scientific_validation_guardrails.phase9_2_recommendation: GO — Canonical labels, uncertainty semantics, boundary diagnostics, and operational-vs-physical taxonomy separation are closed and verified.
